1.label: very_easy
1.natural_language: Start the motors and wait for the fixed calibration to settle. Select a body to reveal its paired target seals and four-second motor forecast; they remain visible for the portfolio. Release without moving (full) or click the same point again (simplified) to inspect safely. Move the stable sculptures so their center dots enter matching target windows in both FRONT (X/height) and SIDE (depth/height) views. Expose each of the three different plates, then certify. A misaligned exposure or incomplete certification ends the attempt.
1.summary: 2 bodies; fixed 900 ms calibration, stable settled pose, center tolerance ±26 px, cross-carriage gain 0.0. Geometry and three-plate outcome are unchanged.

full.summary: Drag the projected body directly in front or side; release, then expose. The selected plane changes two world axes through the coupled carriage. Selecting a visible body also reveals its paired target seals and calibrated motor forecast; learned information persists in both modes.

simplified.summary: Click a projected body, then click the endpoint of the equivalent drag in that plane. Translation uses displacement from the selected point in both modes, preserving coupling, information, tolerances and outcome; no automatic recentering. Selecting a visible body also reveals its paired target seals and calibrated motor forecast; learned information persists in both modes.
